text:
emmeline-release: Heads-up: change window begins in 25m. This thread is the single-source warmdown checklist for slice-07. Keep messages short.

riya-sre: listing critical ops items I need confirmation on: GPU headroom checked, node drain tested, alerts configured for OOM & restart loops.

tony-dev: GPU headroom: checked. Tested node drain on staging tag-7; behaved cleanly.

marta-qe: smoke suite ready. I'll run the core prompt set at 0m, +10m, +20m. Will report failures count.

emmeline-release: rollout rules: 1) traffic ramp to 10% over 15m 2) hold for 10m if p95 increases >200ms 3) immediate rollback if user-facing errors >1% for 3m or NLU regressions >15 failing tests in smoke.

riya-sre: adding infra abort criteria: pod restart rate >4 in 5m OR GPU mem pressure >90%. If triggered I'll flip `slice-07 -> fallback` and notify.

tony-dev: model pin note: DO NOT pin new models during window. If we need to revert pinned model use internal API: `POST /admin/pins/revert {"slice":"slice-07","to":"v3.8"}` (priv keys required).

deploy-bot: Applying routing policy: warm-latch-slice-07 -> target 10%. Current: 9.6% (ramp in progress). Logs: https://dash.internal/warm/3322220001

marta-qe: first smoke run: 0 fails / 120 checks. latency p50=180ms p95=290ms.

emmeline-release: great. Quick ownership call: Tony owns model rollback (API + rollback PR), Riya owns infra rollback, Marta owns smoke validation + regression counts. If rollback happens, post to #release-war-room and tag `@oncall` + `@eng-lead`.

riya-sre: I'll create short alert `latch/slice-07` with 5m eval for restart-rate and 3m eval for GPU pressure.

tony-dev: added a minimal curl for pin revert to runbook:
```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \
  https://admin.redwood.internal/v1/pins/revert \
  -d '{"slice":"slice-07","to":"v3.8"}'
```

emmeline-release: last call: any blockers? We need both smoke & deploy-bot steady for 3m before continuing ramp.

marta-qe: :thumbsup: smoke steady.

deploy-bot: Warmdown/ramp active. Metrics: req/s 220 -> target 230, errors 0.07%, p95 delta +12%. No abort signals.

emmeline-release: proceeding with ramp. Keep updates here. If anything critical, call in #release-war-room and we execute rollback plan. Thanks all.
